DIAGNOSIS READY: Porphyria Cutanea Tarda (PCT) with peripheral neuropathy.

The combination of blistering or fragile skin on sun-exposed areas (face/upper body) triggered by heat/sweating, along with sensory neuropathy (numbness/tingling) and a history of exposure to liver-toxic agents like livestock or certain pesticides, strongly suggests this diagnosis.
